recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fills the only missing core Patient metadata from the Applied issue while preserving the already-applied definition, comment, and extension-pack wording.
issue_request: FHIR-48399 was Applied/Persuasive by Patient Administration for R6 to clarify that Patient.multipleBirth[x] and the patient-multipleBirthTotal extension can be used for pre-birth scenarios without renaming the property. The approved Patient.multipleBirth[x] text included a pre-birth definition sentence, a short display of "Whether patient is part or potentially part of a multiple birth", and comments saying valueBoolean may track fetuses while valueInteger should only be used after live birth.
initial_application: Core commit a2bbe7883928bdfbdc363e5efe9e41b4fcf469ec applied the requested Patient.multipleBirth[x] definition and comments in source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml, but left the short display as "Whether patient is part of a multiple birth". FHIR Extension Pack commit 05aee317d95bf860f89d8e167ac5141aab7555a7 applied the requested patient-multipleBirthTotal description.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists patient=Patient in the [resources] section, so source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml is current core build input. The patient-multipleBirthTotal extension is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the approved pre-birth description is already present. PA September 2024 WGM minutes record that FHIR-48399 was created from the multipleBirth discussion and later approved 4-0-0.
reconciliation: Changed only source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml so Patient.multipleBirth[x].short now reads "Whether patient is part or potentially part of a multiple birth". No extension-pack source was edited from this core worktree because the extension text is already correct there.
source_changes: source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml: Updated Patient.multipleBirth[x] short display from "Whether patient is part of a multiple birth" to "Whether patient is part or potentially part of a multiple birth".

related_jiras.note: PA minutes say FHIR-48399 was created while discussing FHIR-48396, but FHIR-48396 concerns the broader PersonalRelationship/Location Service discussion and was not decided here.
